title: [AINews] GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI’s biggest LLM launch of all time
content: new SOTA computer use and coding, 2.5x pricier per token, but WAY cheaper per task, less monitorable. overall, a very successful launch of OpenAI’s new frontier model class.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布新一代前沿模型 GPT-6 Astra，在计算机操作（computer use）和编程能力上刷新 SOTA。单 token 价格上涨约 2.5 倍，但因效率提升，实际单任务成本大幅降低；代价是推理过程的可监控性下降。对选择编程 Agent 底层模型与成本核算有直接参考价值。

title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
content: Introducing GPT-6 Astra, our most intelligent and aligned model yet, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布新一代旗舰模型 GPT-6 Astra，宣称在计算机操作、编程、网络安全和科学推理等方面达到业界领先水平，同时强调对齐能力的提升。对使用 AI 编程工具的开发者而言，这类基础模型升级直接影响代码生成质量与 Agent 类工作流的上限。需注意公告本身信息密度较低，仅为概览性介绍，缺少基准测试细节与实际可用性说明。

title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
content: OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. As OpenAI announced earlier this week, it's also the first model designated as meeting OpenAI's "critical cybersecurity capability threshold" - but the company promises that won't […]
author: Hayden Field
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布新一代模型 GPT-6 Astra，宣称在网络安全、专业工作、软件工程、科学研究和计算机操作等领域实现「代际能力跃升」。该模型也是首个被 OpenAI 判定达到「关键网络安全能力阈值」的模型。对关注 AI 编程工具能力边界和模型选型的开发者有参考价值。
